## Supply Disruption Analysis – Two Critical Plant Closures

**Two supplier plants closed today (22 Oct 2026): the wheel plant disrupts 40 haul trucks and 5.4 cargoes worth USD 105.1 million, but we have a compliant alternate; the motor plant threatens 10 cargoes (USD 196.0 million) with no alternate supplier at all.**

### Wheel Plant – Cyclone Damage (Material MZ-RM-S400-04)
**Signal & Risk:** Kwinana OTR Wheel Works (USSU-VSF84) wheel plant closed for 60 days from today. Current stock covers 40.2 days; stockout 1 Dec 2026 (stand-in supplier alert ALR-2026-1022-01, SAP_STANDIN).

**Fleet at Risk:** 40 trucks; 49,000 t ore/day at risk; USD 5.3 million revenue/day (MIXED provenance).

**Impact if No Action:** 19.8-day gap → 970,200 t ore lost, USD 105.1 million revenue at risk, 5.4 cargoes (MIXED).

**Alternate Supplier:** **VF Vendor 08 (USSU-VSF08)** is a **Candidate** (status per sourcing policy, SAP_STANDIN). Audit score 93.1 (above quality bar of 90), certificate CERT-VSF08-400 valid to 31 Dec 2027, 21-day lead time, 100% capacity. **Gap closes to zero days; revenue at risk drops to USD 0** (MIXED).

### Motor Plant – Fire (Material MZ-SP-A101)
**Signal & Risk:** Pilbara Electric Motors (0017300001) motor plant closed for 180 days from today. Stock covers 144 days; stockout 15 Mar 2027 (stand-in alert ALR-2026-1022-02, SAP_STANDIN).

**Fleet at Risk:** 1 ship loader; 50,288 t ore/day; USD 5.4 million revenue/day (MIXED).

**Impact if No Action:** 36-day gap → 1,810,368 t ore lost, USD 196.0 million at risk, 10 cargoes (MIXED).

**Alternate Supplier:** **None found.** Status **Review** – single-source material, no compliant alternate at quality bar 90 (SAP_STANDIN sourcing policy).

---

### Recommendation
**Immediately expedite purchase order to VF Vendor 08 for wheels (subject to final stock/delivery confirmation), and escalate the motor (MZ-SP-A101) to executive procurement review to source a substitute or accelerate plant repair – the motor gap threatens double the revenue of the wheel shortage.**
